text:
alex_g: Heads-up: kicking off a config-only deploy tonight in the 20:00-21:00 PDT change window. Small changes: routing weight for model-v2 from 0.60 -> 0.70, batching window 10ms -> 5ms, request timeout 6s -> 5s. Will do canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% assuming signals look good.

alex_g: Diff snippet:
```
routing: model-v2: weight 0.60 -> 0.70
batching: window_ms 10 -> 5
timeout_ms: 6000 -> 5000
```

maria_k: FYI a few high-volume tenants still on v1. Can we pin those to v1 during the rollout? :eyes:

alex_g: Good call. Plan: pin tenant-42 and tenant-legacy to v1 for the rollout. We'll unpin after 24h verification.

deploy-bot: Started config roll (cfg-2026-04-05-174550) -> canary at 5% now. Monitoring: latency, error-rate, kvcache-evictions, tail-p95.

jamie_p: I'm watching p95/latency and 500s. Set alert thresholds: p95 > 250ms OR error-rate increase > 0.5% triggers rollback. Runbook: if kvcache-evictions spike > 2x baseline, rollback.

sre_oncall: Please add the temporary sticky-pin for tenant-42 and tenant-legacy to the rollout task. I'll patch routing rule to exclude them.

alex_g: Done. Pin commands I used:
```bash
redwood routing pin --tenant tenant-42 --model v1 --until 2026-04-06T21:00:00Z
redwood routing pin --tenant tenant-legacy --model v1 --until 2026-04-06T21:00:00Z
```

product_lydia: Any expected customer-visible change? I told support it's minor perf tweak but no feature change.

alex_g: Should be transparent. Might reduce latency slightly for typical requests due to smaller batching window. But keep an eye on p50->p95 delta.

deploy-bot: Canary progressed to 25% at 20:12 PDT. Metrics so far: error-rate +0.02%, p95 +15ms, kvcache-evictions +10%. All within thresholds.

jamie_p: Looks good. Continuing to 100% in staged increments over next 20m if no regressions.

maria_k: Noted one noisy tenant (tenant-900) showing p95 +60ms at 25%—pinning that one as well.

alex_g: Go ahead and pin tenant-900. Also enable temporary slow-path fallback for that tenant if p95 > 300ms.

maria_k: Pinned tenant-900 to v1. Command: `redwood routing pin --tenant tenant-900 --model v1 --until 2026-04-06T21:00:00Z`

deploy-bot: Rolling to 60% at 20:22 PDT. Observability: small p95 uptick but stable error-rate.

sre_oncall: Quick check: cloud region eu-west-1 saw a small latency blip at 20:18 — looks correlated with a transient kvcache resize. Noticed same in staging earlier. Monitoring continuing.

jamie_p: If p95 > 250ms in any region for 5m, initiate rollback. Keep the sticky pins as-is until we confirm stable.

deploy-bot: Reached 100% at 20:35 PDT. Final metrics snapshot: global error-rate +0.03%, p95 +22ms, kvcache-evictions +12%. No alerts fired.

alex_g: Thanks everyone. We'll leave pins for tenant-42/tenant-legacy/tenant-900 in place for 24h and then unpin if metrics stable. Create follow-up ticket for unpin.

product_lydia: I'll update release notes: "Config-only perf tuning: routing weight shift to model-v2, reduced batching window, lower request timeout. No API changes."

jamie_p: One more note for runbook: rollback command if needed:
```bash
redwood deploy rollback --config-id cfg-2026-04-05-174550 --reason "p95 regression / kvcache issues"
```

maria_k: Minor ask — can we add a short post-deploy eval on a representative prompt set to verify quality (caveat: smaller batching can slightly change generation timing/ordering)?

alex_g: Yep, will run the eval suite at 21:10 PDT and post results. If anything looks off we'll roll config back and unpin.

deploy-bot: Closing rollout thread: stable at 100%. Will emit final report once evals complete. :white_check_mark:

jamie_p: Thanks all. If anything noisy tonight, escalate to #eng-oncall and tag me.

sre_oncall: Acknowledged.

alex_g: Final: follow-up ticket created: infra-1257 "unpin tenants after config-2026-04-05".

product_lydia: Adding tiny blurb to release notes and support playbook.

deploy-bot: Final message: rollout cfg-2026-04-05-174550 completed at 20:35 PDT.
